## History

Daniel, also known as Dan Blair, was a local resident known for throwing tantrums every few days and refusing to get out of bed. While [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) were out collecting subscriptions for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society), they encountered a flustered Daniel trying to mix a cake. The girls helped him finish baking the cake, and in return, he gave them a generous donation for their cause.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXI.
